ad_info.reference_style: Clean, modern three-stage progress ad: three circular photo frames of increasing size threaded on one horizontal timeline, showing the same woman's routine and confidence improving, with the product anchoring the bottom
ad_info.angle_used: Transformación / resultado: the 3-month plan as a journey from low energy to feeling confident in her jeans

global_identity.color_palette: Primary: hot fuchsia #E6177F and deep magenta #B0105E. Secondary: bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE, white #FFFFFF, and aguaje orange #D9572B only for fruit accents.
global_identity.visual_style: Premium Latin American beauty-supplement ad: clean pink and blush backgrounds, ultra-photorealistic Colombian women photographed naturally and respectfully, the black-and-fuchsia bottle as hero, clean icon modules.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Feminine, confident, warm and aspirational; soft daylight, believable real-life moments.
global_identity.graphic_language: Rounded pills and banners in fuchsia and deep magenta, thin-line white icons inside fuchsia circles, handwritten script accents used sparingly, clean flat or softly graded backgrounds with minimal decoration (no clutter, no excess particles, petals or sparkles).
global_identity.text_typography: Poppins Bold (uppercase, heavy) for headlines and labels, Poppins Regular for supporting text.

creative_objective: Turn the 3-month plan into a story she can follow at a glance: first more energy, then a steady routine, and at the end feeling confident in her jeans. The growing circles make progress obvious without comparing bodies, and the bottle closes the story.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) Bold headline at the top. 2) The three circles growing left to right, the largest ringed in fuchsia. 3) The bottle centered in the bottom band. 4) The time-label pills and the captions.
art_direction.composition_style: Horizontal left-to-right progression with deliberate size growth. Headline centered in the top band. Three circles with centers on one horizontal line at about 46% of the height: circle 1 about 20% of the width (centered at about 17%), circle 2 about 25% (centered at about 43%), circle 3 about 32% (centered at about 75%). A thin timeline track runs behind them with a small chevron arrow in each gap. A rounded pill straddles the top edge of each circle. One caption centered under each circle on a shared baseline. The bottle centered in the bottom band.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Headline from about 6% to 19% of the height; circles between about 30% and 62% (circle 1 spans 36-56%, circle 2 33.5-58.5%, circle 3 30-62%); captions on one baseline from about 65% to 71%; bottle band from about 74% to 95%. Horizontally, circle 1 spans about 7-27% of the width, circle 2 about 30.5-55.5% and circle 3 about 59-91%. Safe margins of about 6-7% on every side.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Inside the circles: the same camera angle, crop and lighting setup in all three, so only her energy, outfit and expression change; stage 1 slightly cooler and muted, stage 2 neutral, stage 3 warmest and most vibrant. Each circle has a thin white outline and a soft drop shadow; circle 3 adds a fuchsia ring (about 1% of the width) and a faint pink glow. The bottle gets a soft studio key light from the upper left, a subtle rim light and a soft contact shadow.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Square canvas with a pale blush-pink background. Headline centered at the top. Across the middle, three circular photos of the same Colombian woman, waist up and facing the camera, grow in size from left to right along a thin horizontal timeline with a chevron arrow in each gap: tired in the morning, energized after a workout, and smiling confidently in high-waisted jeans. A rounded pill with a time stamp sits on the top edge of each circle, and the largest circle is ringed in fuchsia. A short caption sits under each circle on a shared baseline. The real bottle stands centered in the bottom band.

forbidden_additions: A fourth stage or extra circles
Rectangular photo panels or a two-panel before/after split
Number badges instead of time labels
Charts, graphs, percentages or numeric data overlays
The product repeated inside the circles
Body, weight or medical before/after comparisons; views from behind or close-ups of buttocks, hips or legs
Logos or brand marks other than the real bottle label
Clinical, certification or sanitary registration seals

Across the middle, three circular photo frames whose centers sit on one horizontal line at about 46% of the height and that GROW from left to right: circle 1 about 20% of the width (spanning about 7-27% of the width), circle 2 about 25% (about 30.5-55.5%), circle 3 about 32% (about 59-91%). A thin timeline line runs behind them through their centers from about 6% to 94% of the width, shifting from bubblegum pink to hot fuchsia, with one small chevron arrow pointing right in each gap. All three circles show the SAME photorealistic Colombian woman, about 27 years old, warm tan skin, long dark wavy hair, waist up, facing the camera, same crop, angle and lighting setup: circle 1 in her bedroom in the early morning, sleepy and low-energy, holding a coffee mug, grey t-shirt, muted slightly cool tones; circle 2 in a fuchsia sports top with a towel over her shoulder, energized smile after a workout, neutral tones; circle 3 in a white fitted top and blue high-waisted jeans with the waistband visible, a big confident smile, warm vibrant tones, ringed in hot fuchsia (about 1% of the width) with a faint pink glow. Each circle has a thin white outline and a soft drop shadow. A rounded pill straddles the top edge of each circle: pills 1 and 2 bubblegum pink, pill 3 hot fuchsia, all with white bold text. Under each circle, on one shared baseline at about 65-71% of the height, a short centered caption in Poppins (near-black for 1 and 2, fuchsia semi-bold for 3). No body comparisons, no views from behind. Do not add CTA buttons, price badges, benefit lists, icons, trust seals, rating stars, testimonials, bottom bars or any extra text.

The same woman, crop and lighting in all three circles, progressing from tired and muted to confident and warm

Rounded time-label pill on the top edge of each circle
